items.html: And so did all the seven generations, until they raised her above the seven lower firmaments within her; and then all her ZAT are included in her GAR, and those GAR within her stood opposite the three upper of the NHY of ZA, and held onto them back to back, and all her ZAT are included there. And all the remainder of the NHY of ZA remained revealed, without a garment, and hang down below the measure of the stature of the Nukva; and then the world was conducted by ZA.
